text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio let out a dissatisfied groan. 
Wondering what was wrong, I asked her 
about it—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey~, doesn't it feel like nobody's been 
praising me lately!?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be praised mooore! Otherwise, I 
won't have any motivation at aaaall!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I wondered what all the commotion was 
about... Are you a child, really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I know just the place for the 
current you.

Curious about Mejiro McQueen's smile, I 
decided to follow the two of them.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...I was tricked.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
“I am telling no lies. Wouldn't doing 
community service and having one's hard 
work recognized earn a word of praise?”

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I guess that might be true, but... 
Volunteering in the park? Really? Come on~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Teio-san. Please pick up the 
trash properly.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(This isn't what I signed up for at 
all—!!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew, break time, break time. Nobody 
should be here, right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(It's plain work, no one praises me for 
it, and I'd rather just go back and 
train...)

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"...Hello there. Did you come to help 
clean the park too, young lady?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh? Y-Yeah! Pretty much!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
So young, yet so admirable. Thanks to you, 
there's less trash and graffiti around 
here, which really helps.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
The pond her late grandfather loved, the 
bench where they sat and talked together—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
All those memorable sights are rushing 
back to me... I really can't thank you 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, break time's over, so I have to go 
now. See ya!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Give me chores, everyone! I'll do 
anything!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Just when I thought you had vanished into 
thin air... What brought this sudden 
change of heart?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Actually, you see—

I listened as Tokai Teio told me about an 
elderly woman she met in the park.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I have an unforgettable sight too. The 
race I saw the Prez run right after I 
enrolled!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sparkly, dazzling, and still vivid to this 
day— a truly precious sight...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So, if this park is important to you, 
Grandma, then I want to protect it!

Alright, I'm counting on you to erase the 
graffiti!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Leave it to me♪ Let's go, McQueen!"

Thanks to Tokai Teio and the others, the 
trash in the park was quickly gathered 
into one place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It has become thoroughly clean, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh? Well, if it isn't that little lady 
from before."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Grandma! I'm all done picking up trash 
around here♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Everything around here is totally green 
and sparkling just like the turf, don'tcha 
think!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
We managed to restore another piece of 
Grandma's treasured scenery, didn't we♪

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you're right. Thank you, little 
ladies.

Tokai Teio gazes out at the clean park 
together with the elderly lady. Her back 
looks a little bigger than usual.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Leave it to me♪ Let's go, McQueen!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Honestly! Vandalizing a public space with 
graffiti is such selfish, childish 
behavior.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(Selfish, huh... I was being pretty 
selfish myself just a moment ago.)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's hurry up and clean off this 
graffiti!!

Thanks to Tokai Teio and the others, the 
graffiti in the park was wiped clean in no 
time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Isn't that elderly lady waving over 
there the one you were talking about?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You're right! I'm gonna go to Grandma's, 
okay?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Grandmaaa! The park is all clean now~♪

As Tokai Teio ran off, her back looked a 
little bigger than before.
